          Working as an IIS Administrator Vupadhi Techno Services Pvt. Ltd, Hyderabad from.

          22.08.2019 to 29.03.2021.

Operating Systems                 :     Windows 2008r2/2012/2012r2/2016

Projects Summary:

PROJECT 2:

 Client                 :     Belair Direct, Canada
 Role                   :     IIS Admin & Deployment and integration
 Environment            :     IIS 8.X, 10.0.
 Duration               :     Hyderabad from. 25.05.2021 to 29.02.2024.


Description: Founded in Montreal, Belair Direct offers tailored insurance solutions for
Canadians. As a subsidiary of Intact Financial Corporation, it provides comprehensive home
insurance, covering both structures and their contents. Recognizing the diverse housing
preferences of Canadians, they have developed specialized insurance options for condominium
owners, ensuring they’re adequately protected against the unique challenges of condo living.
Furthermore, renters aren’t left out; Belair Direct extends coverage to those leasing homes,
protecting their personal belongings and offering liability safeguards in rented properties. With
an understanding that every homeowner’s situation might be unique, Belair Direct has provisions
for enhancing base policies with additional covers, catering to the nuanced risks some may face.
Their commitment to flexibility and broad-based protection makes them a go-to choice for many
seeking peace of mind for their homes. Furthermore, Belair Direct also features a mobile app
with which customers can submit and monitor all their insurance claims.

Responsibilities:
 Website Hosting and Management: Set up and manage websites and web applications on
 IIS servers.
 Configuration and Optimization: Configure IIS settings, application pools, and virtual
 directories for performance, security, and scalability.
 Security Management: Implement security best practices including SSL certificates,
 authentication, authorization, and IP restrictions.
 Monitoring and Troubleshooting: Monitor server performance, logs, and respond to
 application or server errors (e.g., HTTP error codes).
 Backup and Recovery: Ensure regular backups of configuration and hosted content;
 prepare disaster recovery plans.
 Patch Management: Apply updates and patches to IIS and the Windows Server OS to
 maintain security and functionality.
 Collaboration: Work with developers, network admins, and security teams to support web
 application deployment and maintenance.
 Documentation: Maintain detailed documentation for configurations, procedures, and
 system changes.
 Excellent understanding of ITIL V3 change and incident management.
 CSR creation, renewal of certs and import/export of SSL certs.
 Good experience in analysis of event viewer logs to identify IIS and ASP.NET issues.
 Good understanding and implementation of changes during production release.
 Good working knowledge on monitoring and troubleshooting.
 Migrating the sites from on-premises to on-premises servers
 Decommissioned the required sites from the server.
 Application reconfiguration based on the requirement.
 Configured IIS web sites, app pools, and virtual directories.
 Strong experience in administrating by using INETMGR.


<u>PROJECT 1:</u>

 Client          :     Suncorp Group, Australian.
 Role            :     IIS Administration
 Environment     :     IIS 8.X, 10.0.
 Duration        :     22.08.2019 to 29.08.2021.

Description: Suncorp Group offers insurance, banking and wealth products and services
through some of Australia and New Zealand’s most recognised financial brands. Our purpose is
to build futures and protect what matters – the focus of our company for over 100 years. It is
based on a strong conviction; we are building a sustainable and responsible financial services
Group that will help our customers, people, shareholders and communities to prosper. We are
bigger than you think, with a portfolio of brands including AAMI, GIO, Suncorp Bank and Vero.
Suncorp Group Limited is a top 50 ASX-listed company with over 9.5 million customers and
13,000 employees. Our portfolio of brands means our people can take advantage of the career
opportunities that come with a large-scale organisation, while also enjoying the flexibility of a
small one. At Suncorp we put our customers at the heart of every decision; we care about our
customers and are passionate about the communities they live in. A career with us is more than
just a job, it is an opportunity to positively impact the lives of thousands of people through the
work you do each day. We understand that there is more to life than work which is why we offer
flexible work arrangements and leave options to support our employee’s personal life. Our
culture, benefits and opportunities allow you to work the way that suits you while making a
difference to our customer’s lives. We have a friendly culture where people are empowered and
recognised for their work, leaders are accessible and people are trusted and respected. We have
been an ‘Employer of Choice for Gender Equality’ for six consecutive years. In 2019, we were
awarded Silver Employer Status at the Australian LGBTI Inclusion Awards, and we also won the
Susan Ryan Age Diversity Award.
Responsibilities:

  Install and Configure IIS Servers. Install IIS roles/features on Windows Server and
  configure for hosting web applications. Good interaction with other teams while
  troubleshooting.
  Create and configure application pools for performance, isolation, and stability.
  SSL and Certificate Management. Install, configure, and manage SSL certificates;
  enforce secure HTTPS access.


Monitoring and Performance Tuning. Monitor server health using Event Viewer, logs,
and Performance Monitor; tune settings for optimal performance.
Backup and Restore Operations. Perform regular backups of IIS configurations and
hosted content; restore as needed.
Maintain documentation for all configurations and procedures; collaborate with
development and infrastructure teams.
Experienced in supporting prod, dev, UAT environments.
Troubleshooting of Sev1/Sev2 and Sev3 outages in SLAs.
Deployed ASP.NET applications on IIS.
Continuous monitoring of ticketing tool and resolving tickets in SLAs.
Strong experience in administrating by using inetmgr and command lines.
Continuous monitoring for High CPU and disk space alerts.
Configured IIS web sites, app pools, and virtual directories.
Excellent understanding of ITIL V3 change and incident management.
Good experience in analysis of event viewer logs to identify IIS and ASP.NET issues.
Good working knowledge on monitoring and troubleshooting.
Provided on call support on 24/7 basis.
Deployed ASP.NET applications on IIS.
Diagnose and resolve issues related to web applications, HTTP errors, and service
availability.
Good understanding and implementation of changes during production release.
Configured IIS web sites, app pools, and virtual directories.
Good experience in analysis of event viewer logs to identify IIS and ASP.NET issues.
Good working knowledge on monitoring and troubleshooting.
Good interaction with other teams while troubleshooting.
